name: What Happens After Death
overview: Scripture reveals that after death, the body returns to the earth while the spirit returns to God who gave it, indicating a separation of body and spirit (Ecclesiastes 12:7). The dead are described as knowing nothing and having no further reward, emphasizing the cessation of earthly consciousness (Ecclesiastes 9:5). However, eternal destiny is determined by righteousness or wickedness, with the soul that sins facing death and judgment (Ezekiel 18:20). Ultimately, the unrighteous face everlasting punishment, while the righteous receive eternal life, underscoring the eternal consequences of one’s earthly life (Matthew 25:41, 46).
